summary: Verified the mechanical-alert bug fix end-to-end plus regression of iteration_11 backend suite. 10/10 pytest cases pass (VAPID key, /sw.js, webpush subscribe/unsubscribe, push/test aggregation, announcement gating, mechanical with/without location, 1h reminder helper) — the mechanical test was tightened to assert the new universal Google Maps deep-link `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=<lat>%2C<lng>`. Web frontend flow verified via Playwright on mobile viewport: emergency 'I've a mechanical' button opens the in-app modal (data-testid mechanical-sheet) with mechanical-with-location, mechanical-without-location, mechanical-cancel buttons; Send-without-location successfully posts and closes the modal; the resulting message card renders as an <a> tag with data-testid mechanical-{id}; existing with-location cards render as <a target=_blank rel=noreferrer href='https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=…%2C…'>. No regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~2640 lines — recurring feedback to split into routers (chat, webpush, push, admin). Non-blocking.
FastAPI on_event('startup'/'shutdown') still triggering DeprecationWarning during tests — migrate to lifespan handlers.

ChatTab.jsx: the mechanical card is rendered as an <a> even when maps_link is null. It has no href/target in that case (so clicks are inert), but React will still complain about anchor without href on some linters. Consider rendering a <div> when mapsLink is falsy for semantic correctness.

seed_data_creation: Posted 3 TEST_ prefixed mechanical alerts (2 backend via /api/chat/mechanical, 1 frontend via UI). Also 1 announcement + 1 leo-attempt-announcement + 1 webpush subscription that was cleaned up in the same test. All harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for mechanical maps_link is fully verified. test_webpush_and_announcements.py::TestMechanical::test_with_location_universal_maps_url now enforces the exact prefix `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=` and %2C encoding. Frontend chat currently accumulates several TEST_ mechanical cards in the messages collection; they auto-clear after 7 days per app copy but consider a manual purge before demos.
rca of the issue: N/A — bug fix verified working. Modal-based user gesture flow correctly triggers browser geolocation prompt; the universal maps URL format (`google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=<lat>%2C<lng>`) OS-routes to native Google Maps on iOS/Android and falls back to web on desktop as designed.
